We need to induce the isotope-5 inside Makeb to release an energy pulse, allowing us to map all of its deposits.|A scientist at the Geo-survey Station|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Quesh Geo-survey Station''' was a scientific outpost of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]]. They were one of several Imperial scientific resources called in to consult on the Empire's efforts to halt the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]'s destruction.
